Business Intelligence Dashboards for Smarter Decisions

We build dashboards, reports and forecasting tools that bring your business data together, so leaders and teams can see what is happening and act on it quickly.

Let's Talk What we deliver
Overview

Most organisations already have the data they need to make better decisions. The difficulty is that it sits in several systems and only becomes a report after someone has spent hours assembling it. We build business intelligence solutions that bring your data together, present it in clear dashboards and keep it up to date, so decisions are based on what is happening now.

Business insights

Decisions based on data

  • Real-Time visibility

    Access live business metrics and operational performance across your organization.

  • Faster decisions

    Transform complex data into actionable insights for better business decisions.

  • Growth opportunities

    Identify trends, opportunities and risks before they impact your business.

Core features

Analytics capabilities

  1. 01

    Dashboards

    Interactive dashboards that show the measures that matter most, with drill-down into the detail.

  2. 02

    Reporting

    Automated, scheduled reports that replace manual spreadsheets and arrive on time, every time.

  3. 03

    Forecasting

    Projections based on your historical data that help you plan demand, revenue and resources.

  4. 04

    Data visualisation

    Clear charts and visuals that make complex information easy to understand at a glance.

Is this right for you?

When this is a good fit

  • Reports take days to assemble

    People spend too long collecting and formatting data.

  • Numbers don't match

    Different teams report different figures for the same measure.

  • Leaders lack a current view

    Decisions are made on information that is already out of date.

  • Data is spread across systems

    You need one place to see sales, finance and operations together.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Which data sources can you connect?

Most business systems, including ERP, CRM, accounting, e-commerce and databases, as well as spreadsheets during a transition.

Do you use tools like Power BI?

Yes, where they fit. We also build custom dashboards inside your own applications when that suits users better.

How current is the data?

Refresh frequency is designed around your needs, from near real-time for operations to daily for management reporting.

Who can see which data?

Access is controlled by role, so each person sees the information relevant to them.

Ready to get more from your data?

Tell us which decisions you want better information for. We'll suggest the dashboards and data sources to start with.
